# Tarkit

> Tarkit connects GTM strategy, growth engines, AI infrastructure, and B2B CRM workflows for teams in Saudi Arabia, the wider Gulf, and Egypt.

## Company and services
- [GTM Consulting for Saudi Arabia & Egypt | Tarkit](https://tarkit.io/): GTM consulting for B2B teams in Saudi Arabia, the Gulf, and Egypt. Build a sales motion your team can own, from market choices to working systems.
- [B2B CRM Demo: Accounts, Pipeline & iHelper | Tarkit](https://tarkit.io/crm.html): Explore Tarkit’s B2B CRM demo with fictional data, account context, pipeline, and rule-based iHelper briefings. Discuss production requirements with Sales.
- [GTM Consulting in Saudi Arabia, Gulf & Egypt | Tarkit](https://tarkit.io/services.html): Define your market, build an owned sales workflow, or scope an AI pilot. Explore Tarkit’s consulting deliverables, client inputs, and handover process.
- [About Tarkit & Founder Tarek Ezzat | Tarkit](https://tarkit.io/about.html): Meet Tarkit and founder Tarek Ezzat. Explore our approach to GTM decisions, sales workflows, and AI infrastructure for the Gulf and Egypt.
- [Talk to Tarkit | GTM Consulting & CRM Sales](https://tarkit.io/contact.html): Discuss GTM strategy, growth engines, AI infrastructure, or Tarkit CRM. Tell us your workflow, commercial challenge, and implementation needs.
- [Website Privacy | Tarkit](https://tarkit.io/privacy.html): How the Tarkit website handles visits, email enquiries, and links to the separate public CRM demonstration.

## Product boundaries
The CRM demo uses fictional data and simulated collaboration. iHelper currently provides rule-based briefings. Generative account briefs are not connected in this version. Commercial scope is discussed with Sales; no public price is offered.
